name: plastic_branchEditComment
label: plastic_branchEditComment
description: Replace or clear one exact branch description (cm branch editcomment, CM 11.0.16.10512+); completion is not stored-state verification.

comment.description: Exact replacement text; explicit empty string clears. Exclusive with commentsFile. Option-leading text requires a file.

commentsFile.description: Explicit local file; exclusive with comment. Stdin '-' is rejected; no editor fallback.

preflight.description: Zero-command preview; does not contact SCM or verify state.

name: plastic_labelEditComment
label: plastic_labelEditComment
description: Replace or clear one exact label description using only cm label editcomment (CM 11.0.16.10512+), never create/reapply/move the label. Completion is not stored-state verification.

comment.description: Exact replacement text; explicit empty string clears. Exclusive with commentsFile. Option-leading text requires a file.

commentsFile.description: Explicit local file; exclusive with comment. Stdin '-' is rejected; no editor fallback.

preflight.description: Zero-command preview; does not contact SCM or verify state.

name: plastic_codeReviewCommentFind
label: plastic_codeReviewCommentFind
description: Read bounded comments for one exact numeric review ID using CM 11.0.16.10512 XML; no server-path evidence available.

name: plastic_codeReviewCommentAdd
label: plastic_codeReviewCommentAdd
description: Add explicit review-wide or inline text/file comment; completion is unverified stored state.

name: plastic_codeReviewCommentReply
label: plastic_codeReviewCommentReply
description: Reply to exact comment GUID. Explicit discard=true additionally discards pending requested change.

name: plastic_codeReviewCommentEdit
label: plastic_codeReviewCommentEdit
description: Replace text of exact comment GUID, never type/location. Empty clears unsupported.

name: plastic_codeReviewCommentDelete
label: plastic_codeReviewCommentDelete
description: Delete once an explicit bounded comment GUID list. Partial success possible; no rollback/retry.

name: plastic_codeReviewReviewerAdd
label: plastic_codeReviewReviewerAdd
description: Add explicitly selected reviewers; existing reviewers are kept.

id.description: Exact numeric review ID or GUID.

preflight.description: Zero-command preview only.

users.description: Unique exact comma-free native users; me supported.

groups.description: Unique exact comma-free native reviewer groups.

name: plastic_codeReviewReviewerRemove
label: plastic_codeReviewReviewerRemove
description: Remove only explicitly selected reviewers.

id.description: Exact numeric review ID or GUID.

preflight.description: Zero-command preview only.

users.description: Unique exact comma-free native users; me supported.

groups.description: Unique exact comma-free native reviewer groups.

name: plastic_codeReviewReviewerList
label: plastic_codeReviewReviewerList
description: Read bounded opaque native reviewer evidence; no parsed membership or identity guarantee.

id.description: Exact numeric review ID or GUID.

preflight.description: Zero-command preview only.

name: plastic_codeReviewSetStatus
label: plastic_codeReviewSetStatus
description: Set caller own review status, not assignee status. Optional explicit status comment only.

id.description: Exact numeric review ID or GUID.

preflight.description: Zero-command preview only.

name: plastic_codeReviewRequestReview
label: plastic_codeReviewRequestReview
description: Explicitly re-request all OR selected users/groups. Never attaches a comment.

id.description: Exact numeric review ID or GUID.

preflight.description: Zero-command preview only.

users.description: Unique exact comma-free native users; me supported.

groups.description: Unique exact comma-free native reviewer groups.

name: plastic_status
label: plastic_status
description: Show Plastic SCM workspace status (cm status).

includeRevId.description: Include revision IDs in the status output when supported.

machineReadable.description: Return parsed, machine-readable pending status records when supported.

source.description: Explicit status source; omitted preserves machineReadable. XML is UTF-8, workspace-scoped, absolute paths, no short/base revisions, with synthesized presentation.

maxItems.description: Maximum parsed items in machine-readable JSON (default 100, maximum 500).

includeRaw.description: Include raw machine output in JSON diagnostics, or bounded XML with a private metadata warning. Never included in the compact native DTO.

name: plastic_changesetEditComment
label: plastic_changesetEditComment
description: Replace or clear one exact changeset comment (cm changeset editcomment, CM 11.0.16.10512+). Completion does not verify stored comment or repository identity.

changeset.description: Explicit cs:number or cs:GUID selector, optionally repository/server qualified.

comment.description: Exact replacement text; empty string clears. Exclusive with commentsFile. For option-leading text use commentsFile.

commentsFile.description: Explicit local comment file, exclusive with comment.

preflight.description: Zero-command preview, not existence or permission analysis.

name: plastic_update
label: plastic_update
description: Update workspace safely without launching interactive merge (cm update --dontmerge --noinput).

name: plastic_add
label: plastic_add
description: Add items to Plastic SCM (cm add).

name: plastic_checkin
label: plastic_checkin
description: Check in pending changes with a required comment (cm checkin -c=...).

applyChanged.description: Include changed items not checked out.

includeAll.description: Include changed, moved, and deleted items.

updateAfter.description: Deprecated in unattended mode. Blocked because checkin --update can trigger interactive update-merge.

preflight.description: Preview command and included paths without executing checkin.

name: plastic_undo
label: plastic_undo
description: Undo changes for specified items (cm undo).

name: plastic_resolveDeleteChangeConflict
label: plastic_resolveDeleteChangeConflict
description: Request source-side deletion for a Plastic SCM delete/change conflict via cm remove; actual resolution remains unverified.

paths.description: Controlled workspace paths to resolve by accepting the source-side deletion.

keepOnDisk.description: Request --nodisk to retain items on disk. Defaults to true; preservation remains unverified.

preflight.description: Preview the resolution command without executing it.

name: plastic_diff
label: plastic_diff
description: Bounded non-GUI comparison. Require mode=file (one local file versus loaded base or revision), revisions (two historical selectors), or workspace (explicit pending paths or allPending=true). No implicit whole-workspace review.

name: plastic_patch
label: plastic_patch
description: Generate a Plastic SCM review patch with a patch-specific non-GUI diff backend; branch selectors are qualified to the current workspace repository and requested outputs publish atomically without overwrite (cm patch).

source.description: Source changeset or branch spec. Unqualified br:/ selectors are qualified only from the exact current workspace repository.

destination.description: Optional second changeset or branch spec for two-spec patch generation.

output.description: Optional new output file path. The package stages then atomically publishes it and refuses any existing path. If omitted, patch content is returned.

toolPath.description: Optional patch-capable non-GUI diff executable for this call (highest priority). Otherwise use PI_PLASTIC_PATCH_EXECUTABLE; non-Windows falls back to PI_PLASTIC_DIFF_EXECUTABLE/diff, which must support the local Plastic patch argument contract.

clean.description: Exclude content that arrived via merges and include only direct checkins.

integration.description: Show branch changes pending integration into the parent branch.

preflight.description: Command-only preview; no staging, backend probe or generation.

name: plastic_branchCreate
label: plastic_branchCreate
description: Create a hierarchical Plastic SCM branch, guarding rare top-level branch creation (cm branch create).

branch.description: Relative new-branch name or full hierarchical branch path. A relative name uses parent, or the current branch when parent is omitted.

parent.description: Parent branch for a relative branch name. May differ from the workspace branch; Plastic uses the parent's latest changeset by default.

changeset.description: Changeset used as the starting point instead of the parent branch's latest changeset.

label.description: Label used as the starting point.

commentsFile.description: File path containing the branch comment.

allowRootBranch.description: Allow intentional top-level branch creation such as /<new-branch>. Defaults to false.

name: plastic_switchBranch
label: plastic_switchBranch
description: Switch the Plastic SCM workspace to a branch (cm switch), handling pending changes when needed.

branch.description: Branch name or spec selected from the current repository convention.

pendingChanges.description: How to handle pending changes when switching branches. Defaults to cancel. In unattended mode, bring is blocked only when tracked pending changes exist.

preflight.description: Preview switch strategy without executing switch.

name: plastic_merge
label: plastic_merge
description: Request one non-interactive workspace merge with an explicit strategy; command completion is not conflict resolution or checkin readiness.

source.description: Exact branch/changeset/label/shelveset source operand; not CLI options.

strategy.description: Default auto uses CM 11.0.16.10512+ native conflict markers without GUI; marker absence is not all-conflict readiness. source/destination explicitly force contributor preference.

forced.description: Request connected-branch-check override where CM supports it.

preflight.description: Zero-command plan only, not conflict/readiness analysis.

name: plastic_mergeBranches
label: plastic_mergeBranches
description: Inspect server merge conflicts with mode=analyze, then apply reviewed per-file JSON resolutions without a workspace or UI. Server aliases, merge links and Xlink effects remain unverified.

source.description: Fully qualified source branch; branch/repository may not contain @; full server tail retained.

target.description: Fully qualified distinct target in the same exact requested repository/server.

message.description: Required for apply; omit in analyze mode. Bounded nonempty comment; CR/LF allowed, other controls rejected. No editor fallback.

mode.description: Default apply creates a merge changeset. Analyze performs read-only remote conflict discovery without --merge; not command-only preflight.

fileConflictsResolutionsFile.description: Apply only: absolute existing UTF-8 JSON file with resolutions entries (exact conflict path plus keep or absolute readable resultFile). Inputs must remain immutable until completion.

unlistedConflictPolicy.description: Apply only: explicitly keep this contributor for conflicts absent from the JSON. Omit to retain noninteractive default behavior; never selected automatically.

preflight.description: Render intent only, zero commands; does not analyze remote conflicts.

name: plastic_mergeToBranch
label: plastic_mergeToBranch
description: Merge a source branch into a target branch with a bounded typed stage ledger; unknown target/readiness stops before checkin and earlier effects remain recorded.

source.description: Bounded hierarchical branch selector. Defaults to the directly observed loaded branch.

target.description: Bounded hierarchical branch selector. Defaults to an admitted source-parent read in the observed repository scope.

cardRef.description: Optional tracker reference in the default checkin message; derived message must meet existing checkin admission.

message.description: Optional checkin message. Defaults to Merge <source> into <target>. Existing child text bounds apply.

updateTarget.description: Update target before merge; defaults to true.

includePrivate.description: Include private items in merge checkin; defaults to false.

preflight.description: Read-only discovery/pending preview, not zero CLI or applying readiness proof.

name: plastic_mergeListConflictMarkers
label: plastic_mergeListConflictMarkers
description: Read native conflict-marker evidence once. Empty complete exit-zero output proves marker absence only, never all-conflict readiness. Observed complete ASCII CRLF exit-1 records report pending; other evidence remains unknown.

name: plastic_mergeMarkResolved
label: plastic_mergeMarkResolved
description: Bypass marker content checks for exact intentional-marker files only, with explicit acknowledgement. One bounded command; no automatic followup, retry or readiness claim.

name: plastic_currentBranch
label: plastic_currentBranch
description: Get the current Plastic SCM branch from workspace status output.

name: plastic_branchList
label: plastic_branchList
description: List Plastic SCM branches using cm find branch with optional filters.

source.description: Observation source. Defaults to native table; names selects strict UTF-8 reusable branch rows.

maxItems.description: Canonical projection rows (default 100); independent of the CLI query limit. Native rows are unavailable.

nameLike.description: Filter by branch leaf-name pattern (supports % wildcard); bounded to 4096 code units.

parent.description: Requested parent branch filter, bounded to 4096 code units; repository qualifiers are not verified.

owner.description: Filter by branch owner; bounded to 4096 code units.

includeHidden.description: Legacy hidden query policy. True is unsupported for names and rejected before execution.

limit.description: CLI query row limit; not a repository total or projection limit.

name: plastic_branchExists
label: plastic_branchExists
description: Check whether a branch exists using cm find branch.

name: plastic_branchDelete
label: plastic_branchDelete
description: Delete a Plastic SCM branch (cm branch delete).

deleteChangesets.description: Delete changesets inside the branch when required; completion does not prove history deletion.

preflight.description: Command-only preview, no CLI or branch/readiness analysis.

name: plastic_shelvesetCreate
label: plastic_shelvesetCreate
description: Create a shelveset (cm shelveset create).

all.description: Include changed, moved, and deleted items.

summaryFormat.description: Print only created shelveset spec for automation.

preflight.description: Command-only zero-CLI preview; no existence/conflict/state analysis.

name: plastic_shelvesetApply
label: plastic_shelvesetApply
description: Apply a shelveset (cm shelveset apply).

shelveset.description: Shelveset spec to apply (for example, sh:3).

changePaths.description: Optional shelve server paths to apply.

dontCheckout.description: Keep applied changes as local modifications without checkout.

comparisonMethod.description: Comparison method used when applying changes.

preflight.description: Command-only zero-CLI preview; no existence/conflict/state analysis.

name: plastic_shelvesetDelete
label: plastic_shelvesetDelete
description: Delete a shelveset (cm shelveset delete).

shelveset.description: Shelveset spec to delete (for example, sh:3).

preflight.description: Command-only zero-CLI preview; no existence/readiness analysis.

name: plastic_shelvesetList
label: plastic_shelvesetList
description: List shelvesets using cm find shelve.

commentLike.description: Filter by shelveset comment pattern (supports % wildcard).

limit.description: Maximum number of shelvesets to return.

dateFrom.description: Filter shelvesets created on or after this date/date constant.

source.description: Native output (default) or one canonical shelveset-ID query.

output.description: Presentation only; does not change query source.

maxItems.description: Projected record cap (default 100); separate from CLI limit.

format.description: Format string for query output; conflicts with ids source.

name: plastic_codeReviewCreate
label: plastic_codeReviewCreate
description: Create a code review (cm codereview).

target.description: Review target spec (branch, changeset, or shelveset spec).

users.description: Exact unique native user names; special user me is supported.

groups.description: Exact unique native reviewer group names.

repository.description: Repository specification when no workspace is used.

preflight.description: Command-only zero-CLI preview; no existence/conflict/state analysis.

name: plastic_codeReviewUpdate
label: plastic_codeReviewUpdate
description: Update an existing code review (cm codereview -e).

status.description: Assignee status, not the caller own review status: Under review, Reviewed, or Rework required.

repository.description: Repository specification when no workspace is used.

preflight.description: Command-only zero-CLI preview; no existence/conflict/state analysis.

name: plastic_codeReviewDelete
label: plastic_codeReviewDelete
description: Delete one or more code reviews (cm codereview -d).

ids.description: Code review IDs or GUIDs to delete.

repository.description: Repository specification when no workspace is used.

preflight.description: Command-only zero-CLI preview; no existence/readiness analysis.

name: plastic_codeReviewFind
label: plastic_codeReviewFind
description: Find code reviews with filters using cm find review.

target.description: Filter by review target branch/changeset spec.

source.description: Native output (default) or one canonical review-ID query.

maxItems.description: Projected record cap (default 100); separate from CLI limit.

limit.description: Maximum number of reviews to return.

name: plastic_workspaceList
label: plastic_workspaceList
description: List Plastic SCM workspaces (cm workspace list).

format.description: Native CLI template (up to 4096 code units), not a presentation enum. Conflicts with fields source unless empty.

source.description: Defaults to native. Fields requires independently known ASCII-only original workspace names and paths; formatter may silently best-fit non-ASCII to ASCII.

maxItems.description: Fields projection limit, default 100; not a CLI query limit.

name: plastic_tool_search
label: Plastic Tool Search
description: Search and enable Plastic SCM / Unity Version Control tools for workspace status and sync, changes and checkins, text-only diffs and patches, branches and merges, shelvesets, code reviews, and workspaces.

query.description: Capability or workflow to search for.

toolNames.description: Optional exact tool names to enable.

limit.description: Maximum matching tools to enable. Defaults to the single best keyword match; exact toolNames requests may enable up to four.

promptSnippet: Use plastic_tool_search to find and enable Plastic SCM capabilities that are not active.
promptGuidelines: Use plastic_tool_search before a Plastic SCM action when an appropriate plastic_* tool is not active. Inspect exact mutation targets. Do not preflight routinely: use preflight for ambiguous or broad scope, moved/deleted path rewriting, compound operations, or an explicit preview request.
